finding: WAVE2B (2026-10-01) re-run: printed 'As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card. Draw two cards.' The draw fires, the DISCARD never does: the second hand card stays home (hand reads 3 net, expected 2 with the fuel in the graveyard). Identical additional-cost-drop as Sparkhunter Masticore — same printed template, same silent no-op, contrasted against the working Village Rites sacrifice cost.
